get.summary: Retrieve the history (audit log) events recorded for one specific entity instance.
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of history events for the entity identified by entityType and id, optionally narrowed with the query parameters below.
Use GET /history/{entityType} to list events for all entities of that type instead of one id, or GET /history/{entityType}/{id}/count to get just the number of matching events.
An entityType or id that doesn't exist isn't an error: the result is simply an empty list.
For restricted users, only entityType PRODUCT, CATEGORY, or RULES_ENGINE can be queried, and only for entities within the user's assigned policies; anything else fails with no access to the entity.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: The type of the entity to retrieve history for, e.g. PRODUCT, CATEGORY, or ORGANIZATION, as recorded by the service that produced the event.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the specific entity instance to retrieve history for (the product, category, etc. whose changes are being looked up).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A number sequence representing a block of items to return as a result set.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Size of a block of items to return. It corresponds with the page parameter.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Filters to events of this type, e.g. CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, ASSOCIATE, or DISASSOCIATE depending on the service that produced the event; not validated against a fixed list.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Filters to events that changed this specific attribute/field of the entity, matching the field name shown in the event's metadata.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Filters to events produced by this originating service, e.g. bluestone-pim, bluestone-tasks, or bluestone-labels.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filters to events performed by this user id.

parameters.name: fromTime
parameters.description: Only includes events at or after this time, in epoch milliseconds.

parameters.name: toTime
parameters.description: Only includes events at or before this time, in epoch milliseconds.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Accepted but currently has no effect on the results - do not rely on it to fetch a single event.

parameters.name: metadataEntityId
parameters.description: Filters to events whose metadata references this related entity id (e.g. a category or attribute referenced by a product change), distinct from the entity identified by the id path parameter.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Filters to events in this context, e.g. 'en'; matches the context field on the event.

get.summary: Retrieve history events for a given entity type using Point-In-Time (PIT) search. Suitable for paginated access to large result sets.
get.description:
Use the 'count' parameter in the initial request to specify how many results to return.
In subsequent requests, use both 'scrollId' (returned from the previous response) and 'count' parameters together.

Note: A new scrollId is returned with each response and must be used in the next request. Always update the scroll in your pagination logic.
